title: BODY MOUNTS
summary: Body-to-frame mounts No. 1 to No. 4 on each side (body mount bolts, cushions/spacers and shims). At each mount a bolt with lock washer and flat washer passes through the body and a spacer and shims into the frame bracket: No. 1 is bolted from the top with a nut under the frame bracket, No. 2 and No. 3 are bolted down from inside the body, and No. 4 is bolted up from under the frame bracket into the body. A body mount access-hole cover beside the No. 3 mount is screwed into clip nuts and sealed with 57c cement. All models.

fastening.note: No. 1 body mount: bolt [1] goes down through P. washer [6] on the body, the shims [5] and spacer [4] (RH) or [8] (LH), through the No. 1 frame bracket, then washer [3], lock washer [2] and nut [7] underneath.
No. 2 body mount: bolt [1] with lock washer [2] and washer [3] goes down through the body, spacer [4] and shims [5] into the No. 2 frame bracket. No nut is shown.
No. 3 body mount: bolt [1] with lock washer [2] and washer [3] goes down through the body, spacer [4] and shims [5] into the No. 3 frame bracket. No nut is shown.

fastening.note: No. 4 body mount (rear): bolt [1] goes up from below through lock washer [2], washer [3], the No. 4 frame bracket, spacer [4] (RH) or [8] (LH) and shims [5] into the body bracket. No nut is shown.

fastening.to: body, at the access hole beside the No. 3 body mount
